description_en: Updates a specified stress testing task
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-benchmark-task --cluster-id cn-shanghai --task-name benchmark-larec-test-645c --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBenchmarkTask

parameters.help_en: The region where the stress testing task is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the stress testing task
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters of the stress testing task. For more information, see Table 1. base description table. The target stress testing task must be in the Running state. You can call the DescribeBenchmarkTask operation to query the task status. If the task is in the Stopped state, you must first call the StartBenchmarkTask operation and wait until the task enters the Running state
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务配置参数，详情请参见表1. base描述表。目标压测任务必须处于 Running 状态；可通过 DescribeBenchmarkTask 查询，处于 Stopped 状态时需先调用 StartBenchmarkTask 并等待任务进入 Running 状态
parameters.name: body

Message.description_en: The success message of the operation
